chunks: Indeed, Allah, Blessed and Exalted, loves one who engages in light-heartedness in a gathering without indecency, one who is alone in reflection, one who withdraws with lessons and contemplation, and one who stays awake for salat (prayer).

key_terms.الْمُتَوَحِّدَ: one who remains alone or in solitude
key_terms.الْمُدَاعِبَ: one who is playful or light-hearted in a wholesome way

ai.seo_question: What kind of character and behavior does Allah love according to Imam al-Baqir عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith describes qualities beloved to Allah: refined social conduct, thoughtful solitude, taking moral lessons from life, and devotion in night worship. It joins good companionship with inner reflection and salat (prayer), showing a balanced ethical and spiritual character.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1372 - Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) said:

"Indeed, Allah (swt), Blessed and Exalted, loves one who engages in light-heartedness in a gathering without indecency, one who reflects deeply while alone, one who contemplates lessons from life in solitude, and one who stays awake for prayer."
